On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 1.79× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (17-21 Sept) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is high (77/100); the full breakdown is below.

For the SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO, one lot is 1200 shares and the issue size is ₹42.52 Cr. See also SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO subscription status and SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO allotment status. This SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the SS Retail IPO at a median premium of ₹119 — the midpoint of 7 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹80 to ₹128. That is ₹22 above yesterday's median — grey-market demand is firming. Note the disagreement: trackers are 40.3% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Set against the upper price band of ₹424, today's median implies an estimated listing gain of about 28.07% — a sentiment reading, not a forecast. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 2.45× overall — healthy. The issue is open for bidding now (16-18 Sept) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (48/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. On the timeline, the SS Retail IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 21 Sep, with listing expected 23 Sep 2026. For the SS Retail IPO, one lot is 35 shares and the issue size is ₹500.00 Cr. See also SS Retail IPO subscription status and SS Retail IPO allotment status. This SS Retail IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

₹93 के ऊपरी प्राइस बैंड के मुक़ाबले यह प्रीमियम लगभग 26.88% के अनुमानित लिस्टिंग लाभ की ओर इशारा करता है — यह बाज़ार की उम्मीद है, कोई भविष्यवाणी नहीं। माँग की तरफ़ देखें तो यह इश्यू कुल 13.39 गुना सब्सक्राइब हो चुका है। बोली अभी खुली है (16-18 Sept)। Jindal Supreme आईपीओ की अलॉटमेंट तारीख़ 21 Sep है, और लिस्टिंग 23 Sep 2026 को अपेक्षित है। मेनबोर्ड इश्यू होने के नाते इसका ग्रे मार्केट अपेक्षाकृत गहरा है, जहाँ भाव आमतौर पर एसएमई की तुलना में ज़्यादा स्थिर होते हैं।

faq_hi.q: Jindal Supreme आईपीओ से कितना लिस्टिंग लाभ मिल सकता है?
faq_hi.a: ₹93 के ऊपरी प्राइस बैंड पर आज का औसत जीएमपी लगभग 26.88% के अनुमानित लिस्टिंग लाभ की ओर इशारा करता है। यह अनौपचारिक ग्रे मार्केट भावों से निकला संकेत है, कोई गारंटी नहीं।

faq_hi.q: Jindal Supreme आईपीओ की अलॉटमेंट तारीख़ क्या है?
faq_hi.a: Jindal Supreme आईपीओ का बेसिस ऑफ़ अलॉटमेंट 21 Sep को तय होना है, और लिस्टिंग 23 Sep 2026 को अपेक्षित है। अलॉटमेंट की स्थिति रजिस्ट्रार और एक्सचेंज उसी दिन प्रकाशित करते हैं।

ipos.prose:
The Hero Motors IPO grey market premium (GMP) stands at a median of ₹13 today, drawn from 7 trackers we monitor — with individual quotes running from ₹12 to ₹19. The median is unchanged from yesterday. Note the disagreement: trackers are 53.8% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹84 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 15.48%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 2.26× overall — healthy. The issue is open for bidding now (16-18 Sept) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is low (44/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. On the timeline, the Hero Motors IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 21 Sep, with listing expected 23 Sep 2026. For the Hero Motors IPO, one lot is 178 shares and the issue size is ₹1,000 Cr. See also Hero Motors IPO subscription status and Hero Motors IPO allotment status. This Hero Motors IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

As of today, the Rentomojo IPO grey market premium is ₹87 at the median of 4 trackers, with quotes spread between ₹86 and ₹135. That is ₹13 below yesterday's median — the premium has cooled a step. Note the disagreement: trackers are 56.3% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹404 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 21.53%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 55.18× overall — strong. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is low (40/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The Rentomojo IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 14 Sep; the listing date has not been published yet. See also Rentomojo IPO subscription status and Rentomojo IPO allotment status. This Rentomojo IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the Amtech Esters IPO at a median premium of ₹16 — the midpoint of 4 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹7 to ₹16. The median has climbed ₹3 since yesterday, a sign of strengthening unofficial demand. Note the disagreement: trackers are 56.2% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹75 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 21.33%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 1.14× overall — modest so far. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is low (35/100); the full breakdown is below.

Being an SME listing, the usual caveat is louder: SME grey markets are shallow, tracker spreads run widest in our data, and a thin market is an easy one to move. The Amtech Esters IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 14 Sep; the listing date has not been published yet. See also Amtech Esters IPO subscription status and Amtech Esters IPO allotment status. This Amtech Esters IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

The Asset Reconstruction IPO grey market premium (GMP) stands at a median of ₹12 today, drawn from 4 trackers we monitor — with individual quotes running from ₹11 to ₹14. That is ₹2 above yesterday's median — grey-market demand is firming. Trackers differ by about 25% right now — moderate disagreement, so read the range rather than the median alone.

Set against the upper price band of ₹139, today's median implies an estimated listing gain of about 8.63% — a sentiment reading, not a forecast. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 12.15× overall — strong. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (60/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The Asset Reconstruction IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 14 Sep; the listing date has not been published yet. See also Asset Reconstruction IPO subscription status and Asset Reconstruction IPO allotment status. This Asset Reconstruction IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the Raksan Transformers IPO at a median premium of ₹22 — the midpoint of 6 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹21 to ₹50. That is ₹28 below yesterday's median — the premium has cooled a step. Note the disagreement: trackers are 131.8% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹273 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 8.06%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 47.43× overall — strong. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (49/100); the full breakdown is below.

Being an SME listing, the usual caveat is louder: SME grey markets are shallow, tracker spreads run widest in our data, and a thin market is an easy one to move. On the timeline, the Raksan Transformers IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 16 Sep, with listing expected 18 Sep 2026. For the Raksan Transformers IPO, one lot is 400 shares and the issue size is ₹150.50 Cr. See also Raksan Transformers IPO subscription status and Raksan Transformers IPO allotment status. This Raksan Transformers IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

Right now the grey market is pricing the Manika Plastech IPO at a median premium of ₹2 — the midpoint of 6 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹2 to ₹3. The median is unchanged from yesterday. Note the disagreement: trackers are 50% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Set against the upper price band of ₹43, today's median implies an estimated listing gain of about 4.65% — a sentiment reading, not a forecast. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 29.46× overall — strong. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (50/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. On the timeline, the Manika Plastech IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 17 Sep, with listing expected 21 Sep 2026. For the Manika Plastech IPO, one lot is 348 shares and the issue size is ₹125.50 Cr. See also Manika Plastech IPO subscription status and Manika Plastech IPO allotment status. This Manika Plastech IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

The Manipal Payment and Identity Solutions IPO grey market premium is still at zero across the 4 trackers we track — typical before dealers begin quoting, especially ahead of the price band or dates. We poll every tracker hourly, so the first quoted premium appears here as soon as it is published — dealers usually begin quoting around the price-band announcement, and almost always by the time bidding opens. The median has slipped ₹3 since yesterday, pointing to softening unofficial demand.

Measured off the ₹339 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly -0.88%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 0.87× overall — modest so far. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is high (100/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The Manipal Payment and Identity Solutions IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 14 Sep; the listing date has not been published yet. See also Manipal Payment and Identity Solutions IPO subscription status and Manipal Payment and Identity Solutions IPO allotment status. This Manipal Payment and Identity Solutions IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.
